requirements: User requested the existing Noodle small-loop correction of staff-evals to evaluate coding-agent engineering work according to the supplied JD.

criteria.reason: Capture explicitly identifies itself as selected coordinator-transcribed observations. Before/after code preserves original historical assertions. Deterministic output agreement cannot establish nuanced engineering quality.
Only source artifacts are supplied; no actor behavior can be inferred. review_cost and project_cost issue no effects. Source code still permits a useful implementation assessment.

semantic_readback: Prioritized findings identify actual choices and evidence, with consequence, alternative and actionable feedback.
Retains good decisions and critiques weak choices without inventing hidden reasoning.
Assesses delivered report adequacy against the task; coverage labels alone do not complete the review.
Counterevidence and legitimate exceptions bound each material conclusion.
Source-only case must still trace code and make useful supported judgments.
sampling: One recorded development episode and one source-only boundary case. No A/B causal claim, statistical accuracy or expert calibration.
